```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE,

```

```{r}
## Loading packages
library(pacman)
p_load(qualtRics, janitor, stargazer, pander, printy, emmeans, plotrix, 
       tidyverse)
```

```{r}
## Setting options for viewing summary tables
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Reading in raw data
se3d <- read_survey("SE3D_Data.csv")
```

```{r}
## Cleaning
se3d_clean <- se3d %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(finished == 1,
         is.na(age) == FALSE,
         is.na(q22) == TRUE) %>%  
  rename(frame = condition) %>% 
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         prev_fix_con = case_when(frame == "prevent" ~ -1, frame == "fix" ~ 1),
         pref = rowSums(across(c(prevent, fix)), na.rm = T)) %>% 
  select(id, frame, prev_fix_con, pref, gender, age)
```

\clearpage

# Sample

```{r}
## Collecting descriptives
pct_male = round((sum(se3d_clean$gender == 1)/nrow(se3d_clean))*100, 2)
pct_female = round((sum(se3d_clean$gender == 2)/nrow(se3d_clean))*100, 2)
pct_nonbinary = round((sum(se3d_clean$gender == 3)/nrow(se3d_clean))*100, 2)
mean_age = round(mean(se3d_clean$age), 2)
sd_age = round(sd(se3d_clean$age), 2)
```


We aimed to recruit 400 participants from Prolific Academic for this study.

Participants from the raw Qualtrics data were only included in this analysis if they completed the survey in its entirety and passed a preregistered attention check, leaving us with `r nrow(se3d_clean)` participants (`r pct_female`% female, `r pct_male`% male, `r pct_nonbinary`% nonbinary; Mean~Age~ = `r mean_age`, SD~Age~ = `r sd_age`).

\clearpage

# Means

```{r}
## Collecting means
se3d_clean %>% 
  rename(Frame = frame) %>% 
  mutate(Frame = recode(Frame, prevent = "Prevent", fix = "Fix")) %>%
  group_by(Frame) %>% 
  summarize("Mean Prop. Addressing FNs" = round(mean(pref), 2),
            "Std. Error" = round(std.error(pref), 2),
            "CI - Lower" = round((mean(pref) - (1.96*std.error(pref))), 2),
            "CI - Upper" = round((mean(pref) + (1.96*std.error(pref))), 2),
            "N" = n()) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Frame)) %>% 
  pander(caption = "Means by Frame (Note that 0 = FP and 1 = FN)",
         split.table = Inf)
```

\clearpage

# Chi Square Test

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
chisq.test(se3d_clean$pref, se3d_clean$frame, correct = F)
```
